cursor.frontmatter:
name: explain
description: >-
  Unpacks an unclear previous reply, or drills into one named item of a
  previous summary. Use when the user names explain, says 看不懂 / 解释一下,
  or points at one item (展开第二点 / 细说这个). Not for expanding a whole
  plan, branch list, or code path — that stays on the original skill's
  完整层. Does not start a new investigation or edit code.
disable-model-invocation: true
